svg.title: China geographic basemap
svg.desc: Natural Earth China point-of-view countries, combining CHN, Hong Kong and Macao, including Taiwan, Hainan, source islands and maritime indicator lines. Full source extent is retained. No scientific data are displayed.
svg.metadata: Natural Earth release v5.1.2; public domain; equirectangular; generated by generate_maps.py. Geographic basemap only: no nematode observations or scientific distribution values.
